verdict.rationale: Dagster's core asset-based programming model (dagster-docs-1, dagster-docs-17, dagster-docs-26) lets engineers declare dependencies between assets in code, and schedules/sensors/declarative automation (dagster-docs-4, dagster-docs-5, dagster-docs-6, dagster-docs-31) orchestrate runs at the right time based on those dependencies; community feedback corroborates the DAG/dependency model works well in practice (dagster-comm-2, dagster-comm-8). missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of complex dependency graphs at scale beyond anecdotal community comments.
